name: faxdock
description: Local PDF fax drafts and simulation. Connect your own Phaxio account for approved sends; you pay your provider. Sending is disabled by default.

interface.longDescription: Prepare and review PDF fax drafts on your own computer. Simulation is local. Bring your own Phaxio account and credentials for approved sends; your provider bills you directly. Fax by Adam Designs supplies no shared fax account, credits or hosted sending service. Sending is disabled by default. Live delivery is not yet verified. No inbound fax or Windows modem transmission. Local records persist until removed.
defaultPrompt: Prepare a PDF fax draft for review.
Simulate this fax locally without sending.
Check the status of my fax draft.
